headline: Verify Fire Byelaws and Access Codes
reservation: The park operates under the Scottish Outdoor Access Code, allowing responsible non-motorized access without a permit. However, new fire byelaws strictly ban open fires and barbecues in many areas to prevent wildfires. Accommodation in towns like Aviemore or Ballater should be booked well in advance during peak summer and winter seasons.

days.title: Ancient Forests and Lochs

stops.name: Loch Morlich
stops.detail: Enjoy watersports or a beach walk surrounded by the peaks of the northern Cairngorms.

stops.name: Abernethy Forest
stops.detail: Visit this National Nature Reserve to spot rare wildlife like red squirrels and ospreys.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes; conditions vary by forest track
days.note: Pacing is a suggestion; allow time for wildlife watching from designated hides.

days.title: High Plateaux and Heritage

stops.name: Mar Lodge Estate
stops.detail: Explore this vast landscape-scale conservation area featuring arctic-alpine environments.

stops.name: Highland Folk Museum
stops.detail: Discover the cultural traditions and history of the Highlands in Newtonmore.

days.driving: Allow 1.5 hours; conditions vary on mountain passes
days.note: High plateau weather can be arctic even in summer; check mountain forecasts.

days.title: Dark Skies and Distilleries

stops.name: Glenlivet Estate
stops.detail: Walk through heather moorlands in an area recognized as an International Dark Sky Park.

stops.name: River Spey
stops.detail: Visit the banks of Scotland's second longest river, famous for its salmon and pristine waters.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; conditions vary on rural A-roads
days.note: Stargazing is best during winter months with longer nights and clearer horizons.

intel.title: Designated Areas
intel.text: Use official campsites or designated overnight parking for campervans. Popular lochside lots fill quickly during summer weekends.

intel.title: Mountain Safety
intel.text: Signal is non-existent on the high plateaux and in remote glens. Carry a physical map and compass for any navigation above the tree line.

intel.title: Strathspey Services
intel.text: Major fuel stations are located along the A9 corridor in Aviemore and Kingussie. East park areas like Braemar have limited late-night options.

intel.title: Seasonal Stalking
intel.text: Deer stalking occurs from August to December. Check local estate boards for alternative routes to avoid active shoot areas.

intel.title: Right to Roam
intel.text: Access rights apply to most land but exclude private gardens and farmyards. Always follow the 'leave no trace' principle and bury waste far from water.

plan.arrival: First two hours: Arrive via the Highland Main Line or A9, pick up supplies in Aviemore, and check the local ranger station for path closures.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are fine for main roads like the A93, but check rental terms for unpaved estate tracks.
plan.goldenHour: Tomintoul offers vast horizons for sunset, though cloud cover is frequent in the Highlands.
